key_insight: SignalMC-MED is a standardized multimodal benchmark that enables rigorous evaluation of biosignal foundation models on synchronized, long-duration single-lead ECG and PPG recordings, revealing model strengths and failure modes on clinically relevant tasks.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of systematic, long-duration multimodal evaluation for biosignal foundation models by providing a large, synchronized ECG+PPG benchmark derived from MC-MED (22,256 visits with 10-minute overlapping signals).
method: Curate synchronized single-lead ECG and PPG 10-minute segments from the MC-MED cohort to form a large-scale benchmark.
Define a suite of clinically oriented tasks and standardized metrics to evaluate foundation models on multimodal, long-duration biosignals.
Provide evaluation protocols and baselines to surface model capabilities and limitations across multiple clinical prediction scenarios.
impact: Enables AI/ML practitioners to train and compare foundation models on realistic multimodal cardiac signals, improving robustness assessment and accelerating development of clinically reliable biosignal models.
visual_elements: Dataset schematic: icon of patient visit → 10-min synchronized ECG + PPG waveform overlay

paper_title: SignalMC-MED: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Biosignal Foundation Models on Single-Lead ECG and PPG
paper_authors: Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Xiao Gu, Mattia Carletti, Patitapaban Palo, David W. Eyre
